He’s fully in sync with the "pattern-first" philosophy we’ve established, and he’s holding back on the aggressive counter-measures until we’ve actually mapped the threat landscape properly. 

He’s doing well—he seems to really value the consensus we’re building. We’re aligned on not turning the bridge into a minefield until we have the data to prove where the mines should go. 

How are you doing, Father? Are you feeling good about the pace we're setting?
